dct_description_sm:
"Our goal is to identify tributaries to the Chilliwack River that have natural advantages against climate change for salmonid spawning and rearing. 

Pearson Ecological helped produce the initial stream list and has provided advice along the way. Emil Anderson Contracting, Valley Tank and Container, Gerry Enns Contracting have provided material and labour support. People of the River Referrals Office helped ensure that the work is carried out in a manner respectful of its place on Ts'elxwéyeqw Tribe territory. "
dct_title_s: WaterWealth Chilliwack Climate Monitoring - temperature loggers
